entries.name: Temple Scrutiny
entries.summary:
A temple, priesthood, religious order, inquisitorial body, sacred institution, or religious authority has begun paying uncomfortable attention to you.

Narrative effects: Being examined by religious authority has made you knowledgeable about its expectations and careful about what you reveal.

entries.name: Tools Need Replacing
entries.summary:
The tools, instruments, gear, or working equipment you rely on are damaged, obsolete, unreliable, or close to unusable, but replacing them is expensive.

Narrative effects: Working around failing equipment has made you good at judging condition and attempting practical repairs before spending money you may not have.

entries.name: Training You Cannot Afford
entries.summary:
The training, tuition, equipment, certification, travel, apprenticeship fee, or instruction you need for the next step costs more than you can currently justify.

Narrative effects: Being priced out of advancement has made you highly conscious of both cost and whether the promised opportunity is actually worth it.

entries.name: Useful Marriage Prospect
entries.summary:
Other people increasingly treat you as a desirable marriage prospect because of your status, skills, money, connections, family, reputation, or future usefulness.

Narrative effects: You are highly aware of the formal behavior and social motives that surround marriage negotiations when practical advantage is involved.

entries.name: Wages Withheld
entries.summary:
An employer, client, household, guild, officer, contractor, or other authority owes you payment and has delayed, reduced, disputed, or refused what you earned.

Narrative effects: Trying to recover earned payment has taught you to argue your case and negotiate from an agreement someone else would prefer to ignore.

entries.name: Want Out Before You Get Stuck
entries.summary:
Your current life is not yet unbearable, but you can see how easily another few years could turn temporary circumstances into permanent ones.

Narrative effects: You are increasingly willing to risk change and attentive to how other people escaped, accepted, or became trapped by similar circumstances.

entries.name: Want to Change Trades
entries.summary:
You know how to do one kind of work, but you increasingly want to become something else and are trying to understand what changing direction would actually require.

Narrative effects: Planning a change has made you attentive to how other professions work and disciplined enough to consider starting again from a weaker position.

entries.name: War Refugee Rebuilder
entries.summary:
War displaced or damaged your adult life, and you have been helping rebuild ordinary routines, shelter, tools, homes, work, or community afterward.

Narrative effects: Rebuilding taught practical repair and the discipline required to restore ordinary life after disruption.

entries.name: Watched by Spies
entries.summary:
You have reason to believe people connected to a crown, noble house, temple, guild, military, foreign power, faction, criminal group, academy, or other organization are watching you.

Narrative effects: Possible surveillance has made you attentive to repeated observers, unusual questions, and the relationships behind apparently ordinary people.

entries.name: Work Dried Up
entries.summary:
The work you relied on has become scarce, seasonal, automated, displaced, politically restricted, locally unnecessary, or simply unavailable.

Narrative effects: Searching for shrinking opportunities has taught you to negotiate for work and pay attention to who still needs what you can offer.

entries.name: Wrongly Blamed for a Failure
entries.summary:
A job, project, mission, shipment, business decision, event, or responsibility failed, and blame has settled on you despite the situation being more complicated or your innocence.

Narrative effects: Defending yourself has taught you to explain events clearly while learning how blame moves through a workplace or community.

entries.name: Younger Sibling's Guardian
entries.summary:
A younger sibling, relative, ward, or similarly dependent young person has become substantially your responsibility.

Narrative effects: Guardianship has made you practiced at making decisions for someone whose needs and feelings cannot simply be ignored.

entries.name: Temple Acolyte Adult
entries.summary:
You served as an adult acolyte, temple worker, shrine assistant, candle keeper, ritual aide, or novice religious official.

Narrative effects: You know sacred duty as work, not just belief.

entries.name: Temple Healer Assistant
entries.summary:
You assisted healers, priests, battlefield medics, temple wards, shrine doctors, or magical caretakers in early adult life.

Narrative effects: You notice pain people try to hide from healers, gods, and themselves.

entries.name: Temple Investigator's Aide
entries.summary:
You assisted a temple investigator, doctrine examiner, shrine inspector, inquisitor's clerk, or holy fact-finder. You learned that faith has shadows, paperwork, and people who ask dangerous questions.

Narrative effects: You notice when piety is being used to hide fear, guilt, or ambition.

entries.name: Town Guard Recruit
entries.summary:
You joined a town guard, city watch, gate patrol, market security force, or local authority group early in adult life.

Narrative effects: You know the difference between keeping peace and protecting power.

entries.name: Village Record Keeper
entries.summary:
You kept or helped maintain ordinary local records: births, deaths, debts, harvest tallies, livestock counts, notices, inventories, letters, property notes, militia lists, temple records, or whatever written memory the community needed preserved.

Narrative effects: You know that ordinary records become important very quickly when people disagree about what was promised, owned, paid, born, lost, or remembered.

entries.name: Village Watchman
entries.summary:
You took turns or regular shifts watching village approaches, storehouses, livestock, roads, gates, common buildings, fires, or other places where simple vigilance mattered more than formal law enforcement.

Narrative effects: You notice unfamiliar lights, open doors, missing animals, strange movement, and the difference between a quiet night and a wrong one.

entries.name: Weaver's Journeyman
entries.summary:
You work as a trained weaver or textile journeyman, producing, repairing, or finishing cloth with enough independence that others trust you with real orders rather than only apprentice tasks.

Narrative effects: You judge textiles by material, weave, consistency, labor, and the difference between something merely serviceable and something worth paying well for.

entries.name: Wilderness Guide
entries.summary:
You guided travelers, merchants, pilgrims, scouts, nobles, or adventurers through wilderness routes. Your early adult work taught you how to keep others alive when they do not yet understand the land.

Narrative effects: You judge clients by their boots, packs, questions, and how loudly they step.

entries.name: Woodcutter
entries.summary:
You earned your living cutting, splitting, trimming, stacking, hauling, or preparing timber and firewood. The work taught you about weight, weather, bad footing, sharp tools, tree fall, and the difference between strength and careless effort.

Narrative effects: You look at timber for weight, grain, rot, danger, and how much work remains between a standing tree and usable wood.

entries.name: Working Where You Were Needed
entries.summary:
You never settled into one narrow job. You worked where another pair of hands was useful: carrying, mending, cleaning, lifting, feeding animals, helping with harvests, repairing simple things, preparing spaces, or filling in when somebody was absent.

Narrative effects: You tend to notice what needs doing before asking whether the task officially belongs to you.

entries.name: Young Alchemist
entries.summary:
You worked as an alchemist's assistant, apothecary worker, potion brewer, reagent sorter, poison tester, or experimental helper.

Narrative effects: You label everything because unlabeled substances are how stories become cautionary tales.

entries.name: Young Blacksmith
entries.summary:
You worked as a young blacksmith, forge hand, armorer's assistant, farrier, tool maker, or metalworker beginning to earn real trust at the anvil.

Narrative effects: You listen for the honest ring of metal and the dull sound of a bad strike.

entries.name: Young Fisher
entries.summary:
You worked as a fisher, net hand, river catcher, coastal worker, shell gatherer, boat helper, or fish cleaner during early adult life.

Narrative effects: You read water by current, wind, insects, birds, and the patience of older hands.

entries.name: Tiny Negotiator
entries.summary:
You bargained over chores, treats, bedtime, turns, favors, toys, punishments, and anything else adults foolishly allowed to become negotiable.

Narrative effects: You instinctively look for terms both sides might accept instead of assuming every disagreement has to end with one side simply yielding.

entries.name: Tree Climber
entries.summary:
Trees became lookout posts, hiding places, challenges, forts, shortcuts, and places adults repeatedly told you to come down from.

Narrative effects: You instinctively evaluate branches, height, gaps, and whether a jump is shorter than climbing all the way back down.

entries.name: Troublemaker
entries.summary:
You were regularly involved when something went missing, rules were bent, doors were opened, objects were moved, pranks went too far, or adults demanded to know who started it.

Narrative effects: You understand the practical value of quick hands and a convincing explanation when harmless mischief becomes inconvenient.

entries.name: Trusted With Small Tasks
entries.summary:
Adults began trusting you with ordinary responsibilities earlier than many children: carrying messages, watching something for a moment, feeding an animal, returning tools, keeping a key, or remembering a simple instruction.

Narrative effects: You understand that reliability is often built through small repeated duties rather than dramatic acts.

entries.name: Watched the Adults Lie
entries.summary:
You noticed adults saying one thing while feeling, doing, or intending another. Childhood taught you that grown people could lie just as readily as children, only with better vocabulary.

Narrative effects: You pay attention to the gap between someone's words, emotions, and behavior.

entries.name: Temple Student
entries.summary:
Part of your childhood was spent receiving lessons through a temple, religious school, shrine community, or clerical teacher. Faith, reading, doctrine, stories, and basic written work often overlapped.

Narrative effects: You possess childhood familiarity with religious teaching and the written work used to preserve and communicate it.

entries.name: Theatre Troupe Child
entries.summary:
Actors, musicians, costumes, props, rehearsals, backstage arguments, temporary stages, and audiences formed much of your everyday childhood world.

Narrative effects: The practical rhythms of performance and musical accompaniment feel familiar even if you later chose another life.

entries.name: Townhouse Courtyard Child
entries.summary:
Shared courtyards, neighboring households, servants, tradespeople, visiting relatives, local children, and semi-private urban spaces made up much of your childhood world.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable navigating the subtle difference between private household space and the shared social spaces surrounding it.

entries.name: Village Errand Child
entries.summary:
You were constantly sent across the village with messages, baskets, tools, borrowed objects, food, invitations, or small requests. Adults learned that you knew where nearly everyone could be found.

Narrative effects: Short routes, shortcuts, familiar landmarks, and moving quickly between people feel natural to you.

entries.name: Village Favorite
entries.summary:
For whatever reason, many adults in your community liked you. You were welcomed into kitchens, greeted by name, forgiven small mistakes, and regularly given the sort of attention other children noticed.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable building easy familiarity with people and understand how warmth and reputation reinforce one another.

entries.name: Village Oddity
entries.summary:
People in your childhood community considered you unusual. Perhaps you dressed strangely, asked unsettling questions, had unfamiliar ancestry, preferred strange hobbies, or simply never fit local expectations.

Narrative effects: You notice what communities consider normal and have experience remaining yourself while being quietly discussed.

entries.name: Village Scapegoat
entries.summary:
When something went wrong, people were unusually willing to suspect you. Missing tools, broken windows, frightened animals, bad luck, fights, or rumors could become your problem before anyone looked for evidence.

Narrative effects: You are familiar with being blamed by reputation and pay close attention to how accusations spread through a community.

entries.name: Workshop Dust Child
entries.summary:
You grew up spending hours around sawdust, scraps, leather, metal filings, cloth, stone dust, tools, discarded materials, and the physical mess of active workshops.

Narrative effects: Materials make sense to you through handling, texture, wear, fit, and the visible traces left by work.

entries.name: Young Caretaker
entries.summary:
Even during childhood, you often helped watch younger children, sit with an elderly relative, assist someone ill, calm frightened companions, or provide small forms of care.

Narrative effects: You naturally notice when someone needs comfort or simple practical care, though childhood assistance did not make you a trained healer.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon Specialist
entries.summary:
You specialize in weapons designed to be thrown, including knives, axes, darts, javelins, and other balanced projectiles. Your training emphasizes release timing, rotation, distance, rapid handling, and turning small openings into accurate attacks.

Narrative effects: Your hands quickly test balance, grip, and release weight, and you instinctively notice which angles allow a thrown weapon to reach its target cleanly.

entries.name: Unarmed Brawler
entries.summary:
You specialize in practical unarmed fighting built around punches, elbows, knees, kicks, headbutts, shoves, clinches, and the ability to continue functioning at painfully close range. Your style favors toughness and direct pressure over formal elegance.

Narrative effects: At close range you naturally assess balance, pain tolerance, vulnerable body lines, and whether an opponent can still fight after the exchange becomes ugly.

entries.name: Tactical Fighter
entries.summary:
You combine close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges with memory, structured reasoning, theory, and technical understanding in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Fighting and +4 Intelligence.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges and memory, structured reasoning, theory, and technical understanding together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Tactical Insight
entries.summary:
Your mind strongly favors analysis and planning, with enough fighting instinct to apply that reasoning under immediate combat pressure. Grants +6 Intelligence and +2 Fighting.

Narrative effects: You usually lead with memory, structured reasoning, theory, and technical understanding, calling on close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges to support that strength when the situation demands it.

entries.name: Versatile Combatant
entries.summary:
You combine bodily agility with close-combat instinct, favoring adaptable spacing, footwork, and quick changes of position. Grants +4 Dexterity and +4 Fighting.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing agility, balance, speed, and bodily control and close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Watchful Endurance
entries.summary:
You combine endurance, resilience, recovery, and resistance to strain with awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Constitution and +4 Perception.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing endurance, resilience, recovery, and resistance to strain and awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Watchful Fighter
entries.summary:
Your aptitude strongly favors awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues, while close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges provides a meaningful secondary strength. Grants +6 Perception and +2 Fighting.

Narrative effects: You usually lead with awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues, calling on close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges to support that strength when the situation demands it.

entries.name: Watchful Resolve
entries.summary:
You combine awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues with resolve, focus, emotional control, and resistance to pressure in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Perception and +4 Willpower.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues and resolve, focus, emotional control, and resistance to pressure together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Teamster's Line
entries.summary:
Teamsters, wagon drivers, haulers, coach workers, drovers, or other road transport workers recur through your family history. Animals, wheels, loads, road conditions, harness, schedules, and the cost of delay became inherited practical knowledge.

Narrative effects: You are familiar with the relationship between road vehicles and the animals that pull them, including how poor handling, bad loads, or exhausted teams create problems quickly.

entries.name: Temple Servants Line
entries.summary:
Generations of your family worked around temples, monasteries, sacred estates, religious charities, kitchens, guest halls, stores, processions, or other practical institutions of faith without necessarily belonging to the clergy.

Narrative effects: You understand how religious institutions function in ordinary life and recognize the needs of the people who rely on them beyond formal worship.

entries.name: Tenant-Farmer Line
entries.summary:
Generations of your family worked land owned by someone else, paying rent, shares, service, produce, or another obligation for the right to farm it. The family tradition remembers soil and seasons, but also landlords, leases, harvest shares, and the constant importance of terms that could change a household's future.

Narrative effects: You understand both the practical demands of working land and the negotiations that arise when another person ultimately controls the property beneath it.

entries.name: Textile Workers' Line
entries.summary:
Weavers, spinners, dyers, fullers, cloth workers, tailors, or other textile trades recur through your family history. Materials, patterns, labor, repairs, quality, and the enormous difference between cheap cloth and excellent work were ordinary family concerns.

Narrative effects: You notice textile workmanship and material quality quickly and understand how much labor can be hidden inside an apparently simple piece of cloth.

entries.name: Tutors' Line
entries.summary:
Tutors, schoolmasters, governesses, instructors, private teachers, or other educators recur through your family history. Lessons, books, recitation, correspondence, difficult pupils, and adapting explanations to different minds became part of the family profession.

Narrative effects: You inherited broad academic habits and familiarity with presenting knowledge clearly enough for another person to learn from it.

entries.name: Unknown Heritage
entries.summary:
Some meaningful part of your deeper family history is genuinely unknown, missing, obscured, or impossible for you to trace. Records may have been lost, names changed, relatives disappeared, origins forgotten, or nobody around you ever knew enough to give a reliable answer.

Narrative effects: You are used to looking for family answers in fragments, records, stories, and other people's memories. Unknown heritage is a genuine absence of knowledge, not automatic proof of a secret noble, royal, magical, or Firstblood origin.

entries.name: Village Pillar Family
entries.summary:
Your family has little grand rank, but generations of work, marriages, favors, disputes, births, funerals, and ordinary reliability made the name deeply rooted in a community. In the right place, people may remember your relatives more readily than they remember distant rulers.

Narrative effects: You understand reputation built slowly through ordinary life, where kindness, grudges, marriages, work, and remembered favors can outlast formal authority.

entries.name: Undead Scholar
entries.summary:
You specialize in undeath: known undead types, necromantic traditions, burial protections, curses, restless dead, vampire lore, religious responses, and the differences between living, dead, transformed, and animated beings. Knowledge of undeath does not make you undead or a necromancer.

Narrative effects: You distinguish different forms of undeath by origin, behavior, ritual context, known weaknesses, and what signs are actually present instead of assuming every corpse-related threat is the same.

entries.name: Underworld Scholar
entries.summary:
You have studied criminal organizations, illicit markets, smuggling structures, fences, gang customs, criminal terminology, covert routes, black-market practices, and the relationships that hold underworld networks together. Knowledge of criminal systems does not make you a criminal or grant automatic trust within them.

Narrative effects: You recognize signs of organized crime, likely intermediaries, illicit market structure, criminal factions, and the difference between knowing how an underworld works and personally belonging to it.

entries.name: Water Arcana
entries.summary:
You have a natural gift for Water Arcana: water, mist, currents, pressure, cleansing, cooling, and fluid motion. Your magic favors adaptation, defense, and redirection.

Narrative effects: You think in flows and currents, noticing where people resist, yield, pool, or break.

entries.name: Wood Arcana
entries.summary: You have a natural gift for Wood Arcana: plants, roots, growth, living material, natural recovery, thorns, vines, and the patient force of green life.

entries.name: Tide Cold-Coast
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the colder coasts and hard maritime communities of the Tide Empire, where weather, tides, exposed settlements, clan duty, and knowledge of the natural world remain matters of survival. Water magic belongs naturally to that cultural relationship with sea and river.

Narrative effects: You understand Tide customs alongside the environmental realities of cold coasts and water-dependent communities. Water Arcana is a familiar cultural practice rather than proof of formal magical education.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Water Arcana +5, Natural Lore +8, Cultural Lore +8

entries.name: Tide Fleetward
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the naval face of the Tide Empire, where fleets, convoy discipline, maritime authority, river mouths, and command at sea carry prestige and practical power. Water magic is a common cultural expression of life lived around currents, vessels, storms, and controlled movement across water.

Narrative effects: You understand shipboard discipline, fleet organization, and the practical demands of working with wind and water. Water Arcana is a cultural magical foundation and does not by itself make you a naval mage or sailor.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Water Arcana +5, Sail Handling +8, Military Lore +8

entries.name: Tide Riverroad
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the Tide Empire's rivers, ports, inland waterways, ferries, markets, and moving trade. Water magic is familiar not only as a weapon or sailor's art but as something useful wherever routes, currents, crossings, and commerce meet.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable thinking in routes, crossings, prices, and the practical geography created by waterways. Water Arcana reflects Tide cultural magic without determining how you made your living.

entries.name: Valenreach Crownside
entries.summary:
You were shaped most strongly by the Crown-facing side of Valenreach: public duty, noble and civic authority, negotiated responsibility, household reputation, and the expectation that important agreements should protect the people who rely on them. Protective magic is unusually woven into Valenreach culture, from defended thresholds and civic wards to the broader ideal of holding what matters.

Narrative effects: You understand Valenreach authority, reputation, formal conduct, and the social weight of promises. Your Protection Arcana reflects a culturally familiar defensive magical tradition rather than a requirement that you trained as a dedicated mage.

entries.name: Valenreach Marchlander
entries.summary:
You were shaped most strongly by Valenreach's marches, fortified roads, frontier obligations, musters, guarded settlements, and the practical belief that communities survive because someone is willing to stand between them and danger. Protective magic is part of that same cultural instinct, whether expressed through wards, reinforced positions, guarded crossings, or personal defense.

Narrative effects: You recognize Valenreach defensive customs, frontier expectations, musters, and the practical logic behind fortified communities. Your Protection Arcana is a cultural foundation, not proof of military service or formal magical schooling.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Protection Arcana +8, Military Lore +8, Cultural Lore +5

entries.name: Valenreach Oldroad Native
entries.summary:
You were shaped most strongly by the Valenreach of old roads, market towns, guild connections, caravan routes, tolls, local bargains, and settlements linked by trade as much as Crown authority. Protective magic remains part of the cultural background: travelers ward valuables, households protect thresholds, and communities value practical safeguards against an uncertain world.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable with Valenreach roads, practical exchange, local terms, and the way distant communities remain connected. Your Protection Arcana represents culturally learned defensive magic without determining your profession or upbringing.

entries.name: Verdant Grovewise
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the grove customs, living boundaries, spirit paths, old trees, and negotiated coexistence that define much of the Verdant Expanse. Wood magic is a natural cultural signature in a region where living plant growth is infrastructure, warning, shelter, and sacred presence at once.

Narrative effects: You understand Verdant environmental customs and the social meaning attached to living places. Wood Arcana reflects a widespread regional magical tradition rather than automatic druidic status.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Wood Arcana +5, Natural Lore +8, Cultural Lore +8

entries.name: Verdant Ranger-Marked
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the trail marks, territorial warnings, monster paths, ranger signs, and practical observation needed to move safely through the Verdant Expanse. Wood magic is culturally familiar because paths, barriers, shelter, and danger are often expressed through living growth.

Narrative effects: You pay close attention to trails, signs, and changes in dangerous living environments. Wood Arcana is culturally learned magic and does not imply formal ranger training.

entries.name: Verdant Treatywood
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the Verdant tradition of treaties with nonhuman powers, shared boundaries, careful hospitality, and the need to understand beings whose priorities may differ sharply from human expectations. Wood magic is part of that culture's intimate relationship with living places.

Narrative effects: You are practiced at respecting unfamiliar needs and reading the cultural meaning of boundaries and living places. Wood Arcana reflects Verdant magical culture without dictating ancestry or profession.

entries.name: Tavern Worker
entries.summary:
You worked in a tavern, common room, alehouse, inn hall, roadside drinking room, or worker's den. People paid for food and drink, but they spilled secrets for free.

Narrative effects: You can tell when a room wants a drink, a song, a fight, or a confession.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon Apex
entries.summary:
Your command of thrown weapon is exceptional even among seasoned specialists. You combine economy, judgement, and control across balance, release, quick draw, short-range precision, and attacking while hands or position are changing, while still respecting tools, resources, environment, and credible opposition.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an exceptional thrown weapon practitioner. Let expertise change what approaches are plausible, but never erase consequences, impossible geometry, unavailable tools, social authority, or established world rules.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon Discipline
entries.summary:
You have turned thrown weapon into a deliberate specialty through repeated practice. You are reliably trained in balance, release, quick draw, short-range precision, and attacking while hands or position are changing, but difficult situations still depend on position, tools, opposition, and judgement.

Narrative effects: Treat thrown weapon as a practiced specialization. The character deliberately applies balance, release, quick draw, short-range precision, and attacking while hands or position are changing; give that training weight without granting automatic success or ignoring normal constraints.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon Expertise
entries.summary:
Your thrown weapon remains reliable when conditions become complicated. You can adapt balance, release, quick draw, short-range precision, and attacking while hands or position are changing to pressure, poor timing, difficult terrain, and active opposition instead of relying on ideal circumstances.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an experienced thrown weapon specialist who adapts technique under pressure. Preserve normal risk, resource costs, physical limits, law, witnesses, and opposition.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon Mastery
entries.summary:
Thrown Weapon has become one of your defining masteries. You recognize advanced openings and methods within balance, release, quick draw, short-range precision, and attacking while hands or position are changing, and this trait grants the signature ability Double Release.

Narrative effects: Treat thrown weapon as a defining mastery. The character may use Double Release when its fictional setup is plausible; it creates a special option, not guaranteed success or permission to bypass unrelated skills.

entries.name: Thrown-Blade Duelist
entries.summary:
You have deliberately learned to combine Light Blades and Thrown Weapons as one working discipline instead of treating them as unrelated skills. The overlap gives you options that depend on both kinds of competence and grants the signature ability Blade in Transit.

Narrative effects: Treat Thrown-Blade Duelist as a genuine hybrid specialization. The character combines Light Blades with Thrown Weapons when both materially matter to the approach; do not let either skill substitute for the other or bypass normal tools, authority, resources, evidence, positioning, or consequences.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: characterLevel 10, Light Blades skill 30, Thrown Weapons skill 30

entries.name: Tireless Reserve
entries.summary:
Long travel and repeated exertion have expanded how much sustained physical effort you can carry before your pace collapses. The reserve is real, but it still has to be spent and recovered.

Narrative effects: The character has greater stamina and is practiced at rationing effort across travel, labor, and danger. Preserve stamina costs, exhaustion, rest needs, load, terrain, and resource penalties.

entries.name: Titan Arcana
entries.summary:
You carry a legendary resonance with Titan Arcana, awakened only through a major story gate, explicit start rule, or manually authored consequence. Titan Arcana governs colossal strength, mountain endurance, impossible weight, giant force, earth-shaking impact, foundation, and mythic resistance. It should feel less like simple strength and more like the world remembering how heavy it can become.

Narrative effects: You notice weight, leverage, load, foundations, and what would break before you do.

entries.name: Titan Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Titan Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Unmoving World.

Narrative effects: Treat Titan Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Titan Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Unmoving World when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Tracking Apex
entries.summary:
Your command of tracking is exceptional even among seasoned specialists. You combine economy, judgement, and control across footprints, disturbed surfaces, broken vegetation, residual heat, and rebuilding movement from small physical signs, while still respecting tools, resources, environment, and credible opposition.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an exceptional tracking practitioner. Let expertise change what approaches are plausible, but never erase consequences, impossible geometry, unavailable tools, social authority, or established world rules.

entries.name: Tracking Discipline
entries.summary:
You have turned tracking into a deliberate specialty through repeated practice. You are reliably trained in footprints, disturbed surfaces, broken vegetation, residual heat, and rebuilding movement from small physical signs, but difficult situations still depend on position, tools, opposition, and judgement.

Narrative effects: Treat tracking as a practiced specialization. The character deliberately applies footprints, disturbed surfaces, broken vegetation, residual heat, and rebuilding movement from small physical signs; give that training weight without granting automatic success or ignoring normal constraints.

entries.name: Tracking Expertise
entries.summary:
Your tracking remains reliable when conditions become complicated. You can adapt footprints, disturbed surfaces, broken vegetation, residual heat, and rebuilding movement from small physical signs to pressure, poor timing, difficult terrain, and active opposition instead of relying on ideal circumstances.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an experienced tracking specialist who adapts technique under pressure. Preserve normal risk, resource costs, physical limits, law, witnesses, and opposition.

entries.name: Tracking Mastery
entries.summary:
Tracking has become one of your defining masteries. You recognize advanced openings and methods within footprints, disturbed surfaces, broken vegetation, residual heat, and rebuilding movement from small physical signs, and this trait grants the signature ability Reconstruct the Trail.

Narrative effects: Treat tracking as a defining mastery. The character may use Reconstruct the Trail when its fictional setup is plausible; it creates a special option, not guaranteed success or permission to bypass unrelated skills.

entries.name: Trailwise
entries.summary:
Experience has taught you how movement changes earth, vegetation, dust, scent, and silence.

Narrative effects: You read passage as a chain of small disturbances rather than a single obvious track.

entries.name: Trapcraft Apex
entries.summary:
Your command of trapcraft is exceptional even among seasoned specialists. You combine economy, judgement, and control across recognizing trigger logic, safe disabling, construction, bait, pressure, and turning hazards into controlled problems, while still respecting tools, resources, environment, and credible opposition.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an exceptional trapcraft practitioner. Let expertise change what approaches are plausible, but never erase consequences, impossible geometry, unavailable tools, social authority, or established world rules.

entries.name: Trapcraft Discipline
entries.summary:
You have turned trapcraft into a deliberate specialty through repeated practice. You are reliably trained in recognizing trigger logic, safe disabling, construction, bait, pressure, and turning hazards into controlled problems, but difficult situations still depend on position, tools, opposition, and judgement.

Narrative effects: Treat trapcraft as a practiced specialization. The character deliberately applies recognizing trigger logic, safe disabling, construction, bait, pressure, and turning hazards into controlled problems; give that training weight without granting automatic success or ignoring normal constraints.

entries.name: Trapcraft Expertise
entries.summary:
Your trapcraft remains reliable when conditions become complicated. You can adapt recognizing trigger logic, safe disabling, construction, bait, pressure, and turning hazards into controlled problems to pressure, poor timing, difficult terrain, and active opposition instead of relying on ideal circumstances.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an experienced trapcraft specialist who adapts technique under pressure. Preserve normal risk, resource costs, physical limits, law, witnesses, and opposition.

entries.name: Trapcraft Mastery
entries.summary:
Trapcraft has become one of your defining masteries. You recognize advanced openings and methods within recognizing trigger logic, safe disabling, construction, bait, pressure, and turning hazards into controlled problems, and this trait grants the signature ability Turn the Mechanism.

Narrative effects: Treat trapcraft as a defining mastery. The character may use Turn the Mechanism when its fictional setup is plausible; it creates a special option, not guaranteed success or permission to bypass unrelated skills.

entries.name: Traveling Troupe
entries.summary:
You were raised among performers, actors, musicians, dancers, acrobats, storytellers, or traveling entertainers. Applause, hunger, masks, quick exits, and borrowed stages were all part of home.

Narrative effects: You know how to make an entrance, find the paying crowd, and leave before trouble hardens.

entries.name: Troll
entries.summary:
Trolls are large blue-skinned humanoids with long limbs, hooked noses, immense strength, and remarkable regenerative vitality. They dwell in swamps, forests, caves, and remote military holdings, where some serve as difficult-to-stop shock infantry. Trolls recover from ordinary injuries with supernatural speed, while fire suppresses that recovery. Individual Trolls may be territorial, disciplined, cunning, cooperative, or solitary depending on their history and culture.

Narrative effects: You rely on exceptional endurance and recover from ordinary injuries unusually quickly, though fire remains a serious threat.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Tolerance +20, Might +15, Brawling +15, Natural Lore +10, Health +100, Stamina +50

entries.name: Twilight Arcana
entries.summary:
You carry a legendary resonance with Twilight Arcana, awakened only through a major story gate, explicit start rule, or manually authored consequence. Twilight Arcana holds radiance and shadow together, creating boundary-breaking force, dusk-born authority, judgment against extremes, and power that can answer both darkness and false radiance.

Narrative effects: You notice fading light, deepening shadows, uncertain boundaries, false purity, hidden darkness, and moments when one truth crosses into another.

entries.name: Twilight Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Twilight Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Equalizing Edge.

Narrative effects: Treat Twilight Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Twilight Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Equalizing Edge when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Underworld Negotiator
entries.summary:
You have deliberately learned to combine Bargaining and Thieves' Lore as one working discipline instead of treating them as unrelated skills. The overlap gives you options that depend on both kinds of competence and grants the signature ability Safe Word in Bad Company.

Narrative effects: Treat Underworld Negotiator as a genuine hybrid specialization. The character combines Bargaining with Thieves' Lore when both materially matter to the approach; do not let either skill substitute for the other or bypass normal tools, authority, resources, evidence, positioning, or consequences.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: characterLevel 10, Bargaining skill 30, Thieves' Lore skill 30

entries.name: Vampire
entries.summary:
You have become a vampire, gaining supernatural power at the cost of a bestial hunger for blood and vulnerability to sunlight. Your body is undead, sustained by the blood of the living. You possess inhuman strength, dark charisma, and enhanced resilience, but the sun burns your flesh and holy symbols repel you.

Narrative effects: Possesses dark sight, blood sense, and supernatural allure. Extremely vulnerable to sunlight (takes severe damage in direct sunlight). Weakened by holy symbols and sanctified ground. Must regularly consume fresh blood from living creatures or grow weak and suffer increasingly intense predatory hunger.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Courtship +10, Blood Arcana +10, Strength +3, Communication +2, Constitution +2, Blood +50

facts.label: Abilities
facts.value: Predatory Senses, Vampiric Regeneration, Dominating Presence

entries.name: Vital Reserve
entries.summary:
Hardship, recovery, and physical conditioning have made you harder to exhaust through injury and bodily strain. You can stay functional longer, but wounds and serious consequences still matter.

Narrative effects: The character has greater physical reserve and remains functional through more punishment than an ordinary person. Do not portray this as immunity to injury, poison, disease, blood loss, or medical consequence.

entries.name: Water Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Water Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Pressure Mantle.

Narrative effects: Treat Water Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Water Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Pressure Mantle when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Waterfarer
entries.summary:
You have deliberately learned to combine Water Arcana and Sail Handling as one working discipline instead of treating them as unrelated skills. The overlap gives you options that depend on both kinds of competence and grants the signature ability Current's Hand.

Narrative effects: Treat Waterfarer as a genuine hybrid specialization. The character combines Water Arcana with Sail Handling when both materially matter to the approach; do not let either skill substitute for the other or bypass normal tools, authority, resources, evidence, positioning, or consequences.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: characterLevel 10, Water Arcana skill 30, Sail Handling skill 30, Water Arcana trait 1

entries.name: Wielder of the Argent Vow
entries.summary:
The Argent Vow is currently equipped as the character's Main Weapon, allowing its restored runes to answer to their intent.

Narrative effects: While this trait is present, The Argent Vow occupies the character's Main Weapon slot and grants access to Oath Unbroken. The trait grants no Arcana, noble title, order rank, ownership claim, or permanent attunement, and it should be removed as soon as the weapon is no longer equipped.

entries.name: Wood Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Wood Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Living Scaffold.

Narrative effects: Treat Wood Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Wood Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Living Scaffold when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Wyrd Arcana
entries.summary:
You carry a legendary resonance with Wyrd Arcana, awakened only through a major story gate, explicit start rule, or manually authored consequence. Wyrd Arcana governs fate-knots, inherited doom, prophecy, curse-shapes, story-patterns, strange coincidence, old promises returning, and consequences that cross generations. It should complicate destiny rather than dictate it.

Narrative effects: You notice curse-shapes, repeated stories, inherited consequences, and the thread tying events together.

entries.name: Wyrd Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Wyrd Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Knot of Reversal.

Narrative effects: Treat Wyrd Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Wyrd Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Knot of Reversal when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Thorough Searcher
entries.summary:
You are methodical when examining rooms, containers, camps, bodies, vehicles, ruins, and other physical scenes. You know how to search systematically instead of relying on whatever happens to catch your eye first.

Narrative effects: You divide spaces into sections and check them in an order that makes it difficult to forget what has already been examined.

entries.name: Tracker
entries.summary:
You are highly skilled at following physical trails through footprints, broken vegetation, disturbed soil, scent, spoor, travel patterns, camps, and other signs of passage. Every movement leaves evidence if you know what to look for.

Narrative effects: You read disturbed ground, vegetation, weathering, and direction of travel as parts of one continuous trail.

entries.name: Trap Handler
entries.summary:
You are highly practiced at recognizing, disarming, bypassing, resetting, or safely triggering mechanical traps and alarms such as pressure plates, needles, tripwires, catches, and hidden mechanisms.

Narrative effects: Suspiciously clean floors, odd seams, convenient handles, and misplaced tension draw your attention before you touch anything.

entries.name: Urban Tracker
entries.summary:
You specialize in following physical signs of movement through settlements and built environments. Mud, wear, discarded objects, disturbed dust, opened routes, cart marks, footprints, damaged fittings, and changes in a scene can all preserve a trail.

Narrative effects: Crowded streets do not erase a trail for you; they simply change the kinds of evidence worth following.

entries.name: Vaulting Specialist
entries.summary:
You specialize in fast obstacle crossing: fences, low walls, railings, rubble, windows, fallen beams, ditches, and similar barriers. Your movement is built around maintaining speed while getting over or through what lies ahead.

Narrative effects: You tend to see low obstacles as things to clear in motion rather than reasons to stop.

entries.name: Vertical Explorer
entries.summary:
You specialize in navigating vertical spaces such as ruins, shafts, towers, cliffs, broken structures, wells, caves, and difficult interiors. You combine climbing technique with close attention to routes, openings, and hidden access.

Narrative effects: You examine walls, shafts, balconies, cracks, and overhead spaces for routes other people may overlook.

entries.name: Wayfinder
entries.summary:
You are highly capable at maintaining direction and position through landmarks, stars, terrain, instruments, remembered routes, and other navigational cues. You are difficult to disorient simply because a road disappears.

Narrative effects: You keep a quiet mental sense of direction, terrain change, distance traveled, and the landmarks needed to reverse course.

entries.name: Wilderness Forager
entries.summary:
You specialize in locating usable natural resources while traveling: edible plants, water, fuel, fibers, medicinal materials, safe gathering sites, and other things the surrounding environment can practically provide.

Narrative effects: You scan apparently empty terrain for the small signs that reveal water, food, useful plants, and workable material.

entries.name: Temple Choir Child
entries.summary:
You were expected to sing, rehearse, memorize hymns, follow a conductor, and participate in temple services or religious performances.

Narrative effects: Performing before others and understanding basic musical structure became practical childhood responsibilities.

entries.name: Trapper's Helper
entries.summary:
You helped prepare, place, check, reset, carry, or conceal practical hunting traps under the direction of someone more experienced.

Narrative effects: Simple trapping methods and interpreting the trails around them became genuine practical skills.

entries.name: Village Chore Child
entries.summary:
You were regularly expected to help wherever the village needed another pair of hands: carrying, repairing, cleaning, fetching, sorting, or assisting neighbors.

Narrative effects: You possess broad practical familiarity and understand how shared work fits into ordinary community life.

entries.name: Water Carrier
entries.summary:
Fetching and carrying water was one of your repeated duties, whether from wells, rivers, cisterns, fountains, pumps, or communal supplies.

Narrative effects: Carrying awkward weight and completing repetitive necessary work feel familiar.

entries.name: Weaver's Helper
entries.summary:
You sorted thread, wound bobbins, carried cloth, assisted simple loom work, and learned to notice uneven material or poor workmanship.

Narrative effects: Textile work and judging the quality of ordinary crafted material feel familiar.

entries.name: Workshop Apprentice
entries.summary:
You entered the earliest stage of practical apprenticeship, performing simple repetitive work, maintaining tools, preparing materials, and learning to recognize acceptable workmanship.

Narrative effects: You developed real but still modest practical craft competence and learned to judge the quality of ordinary work.

entries.name: Young Scout
entries.summary:
You were trusted to look ahead, check nearby routes, watch for travelers, locate landmarks, or report what lay beyond the immediate group.

Narrative effects: You naturally pay attention to routes, landmarks, movement, and visible changes ahead.

entries.name: Younger Children's Tutor
entries.summary:
You were expected to help younger children with letters, simple lessons, memorization, basic writing, or whatever you already understood better than they did.

Narrative effects: Explaining basic written material taught you that knowing something and getting someone else to understand it are different skills.

entries.name: Trusted With Money
entries.summary:
Someone trusted you with enough money or valuable goods that losing, wasting, or misusing them would have mattered.

Narrative effects: Responsibility for real value taught you to think carefully about worth, prices, and exchanges.

entries.name: Vow Made in Anger
entries.summary:
In a moment of anger, humiliation, fear, or defiance, you swore that something would happen, never happen again, or someday be answered.

Narrative effects: Strong conviction can sharpen your presence when challenged, but this trait does not force you to remain bound by a child's angry vow.

entries.name: Witnessed a Birth
entries.summary:
You witnessed or closely assisted during a birth and saw firsthand how ordinary life, pain, fear, skill, and vulnerability could exist in the same room.

Narrative effects: Birth and basic care surrounding it became less mysterious, while the experience deepened your awareness of another person's pain and needs.

entries.name: Witnessed a Secret Meeting
entries.summary:
You accidentally or deliberately witnessed a meeting that was clearly not meant for you: political, criminal, familial, conspiratorial, religious, or otherwise sensitive.

Narrative effects: You learned how much important information can be hidden in private gatherings and gained some understanding of organized interests.

entries.name: Won a Real Competition
entries.summary:
You entered a competition that mattered to you and genuinely won. It may have involved sport, performance, games, craft, knowledge, speed, or another childhood contest.

Narrative effects: Winning under observation taught you how preparation, nerves, and confidence affect performance when results matter.

entries.name: Won an Adult's Respect
entries.summary:
Through work, honesty, courage, skill, persistence, or a difficult choice, you earned sincere respect from an adult who had previously treated you as merely a child.

Narrative effects: You learned that respect can be earned across differences in age or status through conduct rather than demanded through confidence alone.

entries.name: Tailor
entries.summary:
You are professionally experienced in sewing, altering, fitting, repairing, and constructing cloth garments, uniforms, robes, cloaks, travel wear, padding, formal clothing, pockets, linings, and concealed alterations.

Narrative effects: You notice seams, fit, fabric quality, hidden stitching, recent alterations, strain points, and what a garment was designed to communicate about the wearer.

entries.name: Teamster
entries.summary:
You are professionally experienced at driving carts, wagons, freight teams, and working animals over roads and rough routes. You understand harness, pacing, loading, turning space, braking, animal condition, road hazards, and how cargo weight changes what a team can safely do.

Narrative effects: You judge a journey by the animals, axle load, road surface, slope, weather, stopping places, and whether the driver is asking the team to do something the wagon cannot survive.

entries.name: Weaver
entries.summary:
You are professionally experienced in turning fiber and thread into cloth through weaving, tension control, pattern, loom work, repair, finishing, and the preparation of practical textiles.

Narrative effects: You notice weave density, tension, fiber quality, broken pattern, repairs, wear, and whether cloth was made quickly, cheaply, skillfully, or for a particular use.

entries.name: Tiefling — Blightblood
entries.summary:
Blightblood tieflings carry demonic ancestry associated with venom, corruption, caustic environments, diseased places, and toxic creatures. They may show unusual skin tones, dark veins, sharp teeth, strange scents, or warning-like markings. They are not inherently diseased, poisonous to touch, unclean, or malicious.

Narrative effects: Your ancestry gives strong tolerance for bodily intrusion, keen chemical scent awareness, and Poison affinity. It does not make your body automatically venomous or grant poison attacks without another mechanic.

entries.name: Tiefling — Cinderblood
entries.summary:
Cinderblood tieflings express demonic ancestry associated with heat, embers, furnaces, and flame. They remain fundamentally mortal people and may show swept horns, ember-bright eyes, unusually warm skin, soot-dark markings, or faint heat around the hands under stress. Their ancestry does not determine culture, morality, profession, or allegiance.

Narrative effects: Your infernal ancestry is visibly and magically heat-linked. Fire affinity and an imposing infernal presence are inherited traits, not proof of cruelty, aggression, or loyalty to demons.

entries.name: Tiefling — Gloamblood
entries.summary:
Gloamblood tieflings express demonic ancestry tied to darkness, concealment, muted presence, and places where light fails. They may have very dark horns, low-light adapted eyes, subdued coloration, or shadows that seem deeper around their silhouette without becoming supernatural by default.

Narrative effects: Your infernal ancestry favors dim-light perception, unobtrusive movement, and Shadow affinity. It does not make you secretive, criminal, sinister, or automatically capable of forbidden Shadow feats.

entries.name: Tiefling — Veilblood
entries.summary:
Veilblood tieflings descend from demonic lineages associated with desire, attention, temptation, dreams of possibility, and the pressures people reveal without meaning to. Their features may be graceful, uncanny, striking, or difficult to ignore, with unusual eyes and subtle infernal tells. This does not make them seductive, deceptive, immoral, or socially dominant by nature.

Narrative effects: Your ancestry gives unusual sensitivity to attention, emotion, temptation, and social pressure. Enchantment Arcana appears as an inherited affinity for marks, bindings, wards, and persistent magical effects.

entries.name: Tiefling — Wrathblood
entries.summary:
Wrathblood tieflings express a heavier, forceful demonic lineage associated with pressure, violent impact, endurance, and raw magical output. They may have thicker horns, denser musculature, powerful posture, or eyes that intensify when exerting themselves. Their ancestry does not force anger, violence, or a warrior life.

Narrative effects: Your demonic ancestry favors forceful physical and magical expression. Power Arcana is an inherited affinity, while your choices determine whether that potential is ever used violently.

entries.name: Tigerfolk Beastkin
entries.summary:
Tigerfolk Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus tiger ears, a tail, striped skin or hair markings, bright eyes, strong build, and fluid heavy movement. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: A strong build, fluid heavy movement, striped markings, sharp sight, and quiet footwork favor strength and stealth. Courage, aggression, dominance, and hunting behavior remain personal or learned rather than racial.

entries.name: Weaselfolk Beastkin
entries.summary:
Weaselfolk Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus weasel ears, narrow features, a long tail, sharp eyes, and restless motion. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: A narrow build, rapid movement, flexible balance, and quick hands favor slipping through tight spaces and acting with speed and precision. Boldness or mischief is not biologically required.

entries.name: Werewolf Beastkin
entries.summary:
Werewolf Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus wolf ears, tail, sharp senses, strong build, and a more feral edge in posture, voice, or movement. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: Sharpened wolf-like senses, strong build, and a visibly feral edge make trails, nearby movement, and physical pressure easier to read. This trait does not by itself grant shapeshifting, uncontrollable rage, lunar transformation, or lycanthropic powers.

entries.name: Wolfkin Beastkin
entries.summary:
Wolfkin Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus wolf ears, a wolf tail, sharp eyes or slightly sharper human teeth, and controlled watchful body language. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: Keen scent and hearing make trails, nearby movement, and recent passage unusually noticeable. Pack loyalty, empathy, aggression, hierarchy, and wilderness culture are not biologically mandatory.

entries.name: Temple Vestments Set
entries.summary: Religious clothing suited for temple service, rites, shrines, blessings, and sacred duties. It suggests doctrine, discipline, or a life lived near prayer.

entries.name: Traveler's Outfit Set
entries.summary: A practical set of travel clothes suited for roads, inns, wagons, and ordinary long-distance movement. It marks you as someone prepared to leave home and keep moving.

entries.name: Village Festival Clothes Set
entries.summary: A simple but cherished set of festive clothes worn for village gatherings, seasonal rites, dances, and local celebrations. More sentimental than expensive.

entries.name: Tachi
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Heavy Blades. A curved single-edged blade forged in the eastern.

entries.name: Throwing Axe
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Thrown Weapons. A small axe weighted to spin reliably when hurled.

entries.name: Throwing Knife
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Thrown Weapons. A balanced blade designed to be thrown accurately.

entries.name: Tournament Lance
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Lances. A blunted lance used for formal lists, trials, an.

entries.name: Tower Shield
entries.summary: A massive shield built for cover, formation defense, chokepoints, and protecting allies from devastating attacks. Heavy, awkward, and almost a portable wall in trained hands.

entries.name: Twin Daggers
entries.summary: A matched pair of daggers suited for quick hands, close-range pressure, hidden angles, and twin-weapon fighting. Favored by rogues, duelists, assassins, street survivors, and anyone who dislikes leaving one hand idle.

entries.name: Wand
entries.summary: A slender magical focus suited for quick gestures, precise channeling, and compact spellwork. A wand is light, portable, easy to conceal, and favored by casters who want their focus close at hand. It offers less stability than a staff, but more convenience.

entries.name: War Axe
entries.summary: A dedicated fighting axe balanced for armor-breaking chops and battlefield durability.

entries.name: War Bow
entries.summary: A heavy battlefield bow that rewards strength, training, and repeated practice over convenience.

entries.name: War Sling
entries.summary: A heavier sling built for battlefield bullets and armor-bruising impact at surprising range.

entries.name: War Staff
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Staves. A reinforced staff capped with iron for battlefie.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.summary: A martial hammer designed to crack armor, break guards, stagger enemies, and turn defensive confidence into ringing impact.

entries.name: Weighted Handwraps
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Brawling. Weighted wraps that harden punches while keeping.

entries.name: Winged Spear
entries.summary: A spear with side wings for control, binding, and preventing over-penetration during disciplined thrusts.

entries.name: Wooden Club
entries.summary: A crude wooden club, simple enough for anyone to swing but dangerous in strong hands. It is the weapon of peasants, thugs, desperate travelers, and anyone who found violence before they found coin.

entries.name: Temple Doubter
entries.summary:
Religious teachings you had previously accepted began to raise serious questions, doubts, objections, or contradictions during adolescence.

Narrative effects: Questioning belief forced you to understand doctrine more closely and sometimes required courage around people who expected agreement.

entries.name: Unstable Arcana Signs
entries.summary:
Events around you were interpreted as signs of unstable or poorly controlled magic. They may have reflected genuine ability, misunderstanding, another magical cause, or something never resolved.

Narrative effects: You learned to examine unusual magical incidents carefully and to value control. This trait does not independently establish an Arcana.

entries.name: Unwanted Local Fame
entries.summary:
Something you did, survived, won, failed at, were accused of, or became associated with made you locally recognizable in ways you did not entirely welcome.

Narrative effects: You learned to manage yourself while being watched and to pay attention to what people believe about someone they think they know.

entries.name: Village Scapegoat as a Teen
entries.summary:
Your community developed a habit of blaming you for trouble, bad influence, rumors, broken rules, or things that happened nearby whether you deserved it or not.

Narrative effects: Repeated accusation taught you to stand under social pressure and argue your case when reputation turns against you.

entries.name: Wages Were Stolen
entries.summary:
Someone withheld, skimmed, seized, falsified, or otherwise took wages or payment you had legitimately earned.

Narrative effects: The experience taught you to pay closer attention to agreed terms and to recognize dishonest explanations around money.

entries.name: War Refugee Teen
entries.summary:
War forced you from somewhere you considered home and made displacement, temporary shelter, dangerous roads, or uncertain borders part of your teenage years.

Narrative effects: Displacement taught you to move through unfamiliar territory while reading the practical consequences of conflict.

entries.name: Watched by Noble Spies
entries.summary:
You became aware that someone connected to a noble house, court faction, wealthy household, or political patron was watching you.

Narrative effects: You became practiced at noticing surveillance and reducing how much an observer could easily learn about your movements.

entries.name: Watched by Temple Agents
entries.summary:
Priests, inquisitors, temple servants, religious officials, or other agents of a faith began paying unusual attention to you or your activities.

Narrative effects: You became attentive to surveillance and learned enough about the religious institution involved to recognize some of its people and methods.

entries.name: Worked Two Jobs
entries.summary:
For a meaningful period, you balanced two different forms of paid or necessary work because one alone was not enough.

Narrative effects: Managing competing demands taught you discipline and made the value of your time difficult to ignore.

entries.name: Wrongly Accused
entries.summary:
You were seriously accused of misconduct, theft, dishonesty, betrayal, violence, or another offense you did not actually commit.

Narrative effects: Defending yourself taught you how much reputation and social belief matter when evidence is incomplete.

entries.name: Teenage Shrine Acolyte
entries.summary:
You served regularly at a shrine, helping with ceremonies, visitors, offerings, preparation, maintenance, and the social expectations surrounding religious practice.

Narrative effects: Faith practices and respectful ceremonial behavior became sustained responsibilities rather than occasional childhood exposure.

entries.name: Temple Choir Teen
entries.summary:
You trained and performed regularly as part of a temple choir or other religious musical tradition during adolescence.

Narrative effects: Repeated rehearsal and public religious performance gave you strong practical performance experience and substantial musical understanding.

entries.name: Temple Novice
entries.summary:
You spent your teenage years preparing for a possible religious life through doctrine, ritual, service, discipline, and close participation in temple routines.

Narrative effects: You possess sustained religious training without this trait requiring that you ultimately joined the clergy or retained the faith.

entries.name: Tournament Hopeful
entries.summary:
You trained seriously with the hope of proving yourself in tournaments, public bouts, martial contests, or formal competitions.

Narrative effects: Competitive training gave you strong formal fighting fundamentals and experience with heavier tournament weapons.

entries.name: Traveling Troupe Teen
entries.summary:
Your teenage years were spent traveling with performers, entertainers, festival workers, musicians, storytellers, or another troupe that regularly moved between communities.

Narrative effects: Regular performance developed alongside broad exposure to the customs and audiences of different communities.

entries.name: Village Skirmisher
entries.summary:
You trained or regularly practiced with inexpensive ranged weapons useful for hunting, pest control, local defense, games, or harassment of threats from a distance.

Narrative effects: You developed a strong foundation in accessible skirmishing weapons without requiring wealthy or formal military circumstances.

entries.name: Watch Cadet
entries.summary:
You trained with a town watch, city guard, gate guard, caravan watch, or similar organization where ranged readiness and practical close-defense weapons were valued.

Narrative effects: You developed a practical guard's fighting foundation using a reliable ranged weapon backed by close-range impact weapons.

entries.name: Weaver's Apprentice
entries.summary:
You trained in preparing thread, operating looms, correcting mistakes, repairing cloth, understanding patterns, and judging finished textiles.

Narrative effects: Textile production became a substantial craft skill supported by a practiced eye for material and workmanship.

entries.name: Young Soldier
entries.summary:
You entered genuine military service or sustained military training while still a teenager. Drills, weapon practice, watches, equipment, commands, and unit expectations became part of daily life.

Narrative effects: You developed a practical soldier's foundation in formation-friendly reach weapons and disciplined ranged fire.

entries.name: Taken in by Strangers
entries.summary:
You were taken in by people who had no obligation to keep you. Their reasons may have been love, pity, guilt, duty, prophecy, or simple decency, but your earliest safety came from strangers.

Narrative effects: You remember kindness as something chosen, not guaranteed.

entries.name: Temple Cradle
entries.summary:
Your earliest surroundings included temple bells, prayer cloths, holy symbols, rites, incense, hymns, or the watchful care of religious attendants.

Narrative effects: You find rhythm in bells, prayers, incense, and the hush before sacred words.

entries.name: Travelled Constantly
entries.summary:
Your first years involved repeated movement between settlements, camps, estates, roads, ships, or temporary lodgings. Staying somewhere long enough for it to become permanent was unusual.

Narrative effects: Changing routes and local customs feel natural to you, and you are slow to assume that one place's habits are universal.

entries.name: Twin Separated Early
entries.summary:
You had a twin or same-age sibling-like companion from whom you were separated while still very young. You may remember little directly, but the separation remained part of the story adults told about your beginning.

Narrative effects: You take questions of missing relatives and separated lives seriously without assuming reunion will automatically restore closeness.

entries.name: Twin Who Stayed Close
entries.summary:
You shared your earliest years with a twin or another child so close in age and circumstance that adults treated you as a pair. Shared routines, comparison, imitation, and constant companionship shaped your first social instincts.

Narrative effects: You are sensitive to subtle differences between people others lazily group together and understand how shared identity can coexist with individual needs.

entries.name: Village-Carried Child
entries.summary:
You were passed between neighbors, aunties, elders, siblings, field workers, and shopkeepers as a toddler. The village did not belong to one parent alone; it collectively knew your name, habits, and cries.

Narrative effects: You expect familiar communities to pass children from arm to arm without ceremony.

entries.name: Watched by Many Cousins
entries.summary:
Older cousins, siblings, neighborhood children, wards, or other youngsters regularly helped watch you. Your first caregivers were not always adults, and group responsibility became normal early.

Narrative effects: You understand informal group responsibility and the way authority can arise from age, confidence, or circumstance rather than formal rank.

entries.name: Youngest in a Crowd
entries.summary:
You were the youngest among many siblings, cousins, wards, neighborhood children, or other youngsters. Noise, older examples, hand-me-downs, interrupted attention, and following people bigger than you shaped your first years.

Narrative effects: You instinctively read older companions and pick useful information out of noisy group environments.

entries.name: Tiny Escape Artist
entries.summary:
Latches, blankets, playpens, closed rooms, inattentive adults, and supposedly secure boundaries repeatedly failed to keep you where you were placed.

Narrative effects: Your hands instinctively test simple closures and your first response to confinement is often to look for a way around it.

entries.name: Took Things Apart
entries.summary:
Objects were rarely safe from your curiosity. Toys, boxes, hinges, utensils, simple mechanisms, and anything with visible pieces invited investigation.

Narrative effects: When confronted with a constructed object, you instinctively wonder how its pieces actually work together.

entries.name: Wandered Off Constantly
entries.summary:
If someone looked away for too long, you were likely to be somewhere else. Paths, rooms, alleys, gardens, fields, and anything beyond the expected boundary drew you onward.

Narrative effects: You naturally explore unfamiliar places and build a sense of how spaces connect.

entries.name: Wanted to Do It Alone
entries.summary:
Help was often met with an indignant attempt to do the task yourself. Dressing, carrying, opening, building, eating, climbing, and fixing became matters of stubborn independence.

Narrative effects: Your instinct is to try a practical task yourself before admitting that you need assistance.

entries.name: Watched Craftspeople Work
entries.summary:
You could sit remarkably still when someone was carving, sewing, repairing, forging, painting, shaping, or assembling something by hand.

Narrative effects: Your attention naturally follows the steps by which physical objects are made and how workmanship affects their quality.

entries.name: Woke at Every Sound
entries.summary:
Doors, footsteps, whispers, animals, storms, and movement woke you easily. Your attention seemed tuned to sounds other children slept through.

Narrative effects: Unexpected sounds catch your attention quickly, though you have learned not to react visibly to every disturbance.

entries.name: Would Not Be Held
entries.summary:
You squirmed, twisted, climbed down, and fought free whenever someone tried to keep you still. Affection was welcome on your terms, but restraint rarely was.

Narrative effects: You instinctively resist being physically restrained and prefer freedom of movement.

entries.name: Technical Study
entries.summary:
You deliberately studied mechanisms, materials, construction, repair, and the practical logic behind how made things function and fail. Grants +2 Intelligence and +1 Dexterity.

Narrative effects: You inspect joins, wear, material choice, tolerances, and construction logic before deciding how something works or how it should be repaired.

entries.name: Throwing Practice
entries.summary:
You practiced controlled throwing until distance, release angle, weight, spin, and hand position became familiar rather than improvised. Grants +2 Accuracy and +1 Dexterity.

Narrative effects: You test an object's weight and balance quickly and instinctively adjust release timing to distance and motion.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Thrown Weapons +8, Touching +5, Seeing +3, Accuracy +2, Dexterity +1

entries.name: Trail Awareness
entries.summary:
You trained to recognize tracks, disturbed terrain, scent, broken vegetation, and other signs that reveal movement through an environment. Grants +2 Perception and +1 Dexterity.

Narrative effects: You notice what has been pressed, broken, displaced, carried, or left behind and naturally compare those signs with the surrounding terrain.

entries.name: Warrior's Regimen
entries.summary:
You were drilled in the broad foundations of close combat: stance, guard, impact, pressure, fear control, and continuing to function while someone is actively trying to hurt you. Grants +2 Fighting and +1 Constitution.

Narrative effects: You naturally check distance, guard position, footing, exits, and who is armed before fully relaxing in a dangerous space.

entries.name: Temple Raised
entries.summary:
You were raised by or around a temple, shrine complex, religious household, or active sacred community. Prayer, service, ceremonies, visitors, doctrine, sacred rules, and public expectations shaped daily life.

Narrative effects: You recognize religious customs and ceremonial conduct without this trait determining whether you personally believe the doctrine.

entries.name: Tiefling Quarter
entries.summary:
You were raised in a tiefling-majority neighborhood or community with its own households, businesses, customs, celebrations, disputes, mutual support, and relationships with surrounding society. You need not be a tiefling yourself.

Narrative effects: You understand the community as a lived culture rather than assuming tiefling ancestry determines criminality, deception, morality, or temperament.

entries.name: Traveling Theatre Troupe
entries.summary:
You grew up among actors, musicians, storytellers, stagehands, wagons, costumes, rehearsals, temporary stages, audiences, new towns, disappointing crowds, successful nights, and constant travel.

Narrative effects: You understand performing for an audience and possess familiarity with musical traditions and performance theory.

entries.name: War-Torn Province
entries.summary:
You were raised where war had recently passed, never fully left, or repeatedly threatened to return. Troops, damaged infrastructure, sudden danger, displaced people, alarms, shortages, and visible consequences of violence shaped ordinary life.

Narrative effects: Repeated exposure to serious danger taught you to keep acting under threat and to pay close attention to visible changes around you, without making war itself harmless or ordinary.

entries.name: Workhouse Raised
entries.summary:
Much of your upbringing took place in an institution where shelter, food, supervision, and strict rules were tied to assigned labor or communal work. Conditions could vary widely, but personal choice was limited by institutional routine.

Narrative effects: You understand rigid institutional routine and the customs, expectations, and social structures surrounding organized poor relief or compulsory communal labor.

entries.name: Workshop Row
entries.summary:
You grew up in a district crowded with workshops rather than within a single craft. Woodworkers, leatherworkers, tailors, jewelers, repairers, toolmakers, and other craftspeople worked close enough that different materials and techniques became familiar.

Narrative effects: You have broad familiarity with physical fabrication and pay close attention to texture, temperature, surface condition, fitting, and material through touch.
